condition: In runtimes whose crypto module has no KeyObject (older Bun, or browser/client bundles such as webpack or Next.js client code), jwt.sign/jwt.verify in 9.x throw "Right hand side of instanceof is not an object".
workaround: Run it on server-side Node or upgrade Bun to a build that has crypto.KeyObject (e.g. the canary). Otherwise, downgrade to jsonwebtoken 8.5.1 or switch to the jose library.
